items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And he got it not only with Wallace, but with Antoine [Roney].

ctx.x: He was like a jazz – I would call him – you got stage mothers. He was – meaning theatrical stage mothers. He was a jazz dad. He was a jazz stage dad. And he got it not only with Wallace, but with Antoine [Roney]. Got that from filming.
